statement: Under these hypotheses, N > 0 throughout M, and M is simply connected. The fields h = g + N−1 X♭ ⊗ X♭ , λ = √ N, A = N−1 X♭ (9.5) satisfy h ≥ g and dA = 0, and there is a global smooth function H on M with dH = −A. They obey ∆hλ = 3λ, Hessh λ = λ(Rich +3h), Rh = −6. (9.6) Attaching S in the regular boundary coordinates of Lemma 9.14 gives a smooth complete Rie- mannian manifold with compact connected nondegenerate boundary. Its underlying completion is homeomorphic to Ω, and its boundary is identified diffeomorphically with S. On that boundary, h|TS = g|TS, Areah(S) = Areag(S), λ = 0, ∂νh λ = κh, IIh = 0. (9.7) Moreover, in the original end chart, h − g = O2(r−2τ′ ), λ − V0 = O2(r1−τ′ ), λ V0 −→ 1. (9.8)
